tables.name: Halingo Naming Method
tables.description: 9 methods. Fused Frontier (26%) and Inherited Desert (24%) are the two most common; Single-Word remains rare on d100 rolls 99-00 (2%).

results.name: Geographic & Landmark
results.description: Terrain, local colour and stable topographic markers.

results.name: Water & Survival
results.description: Water, shelter and risk: names that tell travellers where they might endure.

results.name: Prospecting & Industry
results.description: Resource, mining, workshop and Ichor extraction settlements.

results.name: Roads, Rails & Commerce
results.description: Junctions, sidings, trade hubs, relays and transport-linked sites.

results.name: Fused Frontier Name
results.description: A curated single-word place-name formed from ordinary landscape and mining words.

results.name: Landholder & Claim
results.description: Former proprietors, claim-holders and private operators, not necessarily honoured ancestors.

results.name: Inherited Desert Name
results.description: An inherited one-piece proper toponym from an older regional language layer.

results.name: Disaster & Warning
results.description: Rare place names remembered because of ruin, danger or a warning.

results.name: Single-Word Name
results.description: Very rare abstract or ordinary one-word name: Malice, Mercy, Dissent and similar; Heresy is reserved.
